One CouchDB URL for the probe, the tests and default stores (#5)

The default store URL now follows COUCHDB_URL (else http://127.0.0.1:5984),
via couchdol.default_couchdb_url(). conftest probes that URL, hands it to
tests through a couchdb_url fixture, and skips only the items that need a
server (tests requesting the fixture, and the doctests).
